flagship_project.title: Baylor Athletics x SAP Corporate Partnership Pitch
flagship_project.description: A full 7-page interactive digital pitch deck built from scratch proposing a B2B sponsorship ecosystem between Baylor Athletics and SAP. This is the most ambitious and technically polished project in the portfolio. It includes a live AI Briefing Assistant, custom analytics dashboard, jersey patch valuation, suite packages, keynote series, and fan app concept.
flagship_project.why_impressive: This is not a class deck. It is a fully deployed, multi-page interactive website that mirrors a real enterprise sales pitch — complete with client needs analysis, pillar strategy, ROI valuation, and a working chatbot that answers executive questions about the proposal.

key_facts.jersey_patch: 4.2M annual TV viewers, 300K+ home attendees, first B2B tech jersey patch in the South
key_facts.core_objective: Mid-market demand generation, pipeline value, and young talent recruitment for SAP
pillars: Pillar 1 - Integration & VIK: SAP Analytics Cloud embedded into Baylor Athletics operations, replacing legacy systems. Exclusive category ownership and live collegiate reference story for Sapphire and TechEd.
Pillar 2 - Mid-Market Growth: The I-35 corridor has the highest concentration of $500M-$2B companies in Texas. Baylor delivers SAP to that audience 300,000+ times per year at the C-suite level.
Pillar 3 - Sustainable Partnership: Multi-year platform, not a one-year buy. Technology integration, speaking engagements, and co-innovation from day one.
Pillar 4 - Local Anchor Strategy: SAP's global plays (F1, NHL, Wimbledon) deliver scale. Baylor delivers a concentrated, high-intent B2B audience in SAP's highest-priority growth corridor.
